notes.title: Update 0.5.7
notes.notes:
🧟‍♂️ Hello, Survivors!

Today, we're wrapping up our Halloween-themed event—it was a blast seeing Uncle dressed up as Frankenstein! Rest assured, more themed events with exciting new content are on the way!

Now, we’d like to share our roadmap for the official release of Uncle Z:


 Combat System Overhaul: We plan to completely revamp the combat system to make gameplay more dynamic, accessible, and fun, with firearms playing a more significant role.

 Inventory and Backpack System Overhaul: We’re reworking the game’s UI for clarity and accessibility. A new item belt will be added, giving the player two item slots that can be expanded by finding a backpack.

 Mission System Overhaul: The mission system will be revamped for game progression. Currently, it’s a bit hidden, so many players feel lost without clear objectives. Our new tutorial system gives a sneak peek of what's to come.

 Enhanced Gore Effects: We plan to add more gore and zombie reactions—you’ll see heads flying and smashing apart for maximum impact, haha!

 Advanced Match Configuration in the Lobby: A match customization menu will be added, letting the host configure the game to their preferences, from zombie and item spawn rates to infection settings and more.

 Map Expansions and New Maps: We aim to expand existing maps and add a procedural system so that each expedition introduces subtle map changes—like a burning bus blocking access or an extremely barricaded door, for instance.


These are our main goals before the final release of Uncle Z. We’d like to thank you once again for all your support, feedback, and bug reports—they’re what make Uncle Z such a unique and enjoyable game! With our small dev team (just my brother and me), your help is invaluable. Thank you for your patience and continued support!

notes.title: Update 0.5.6
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.notes:
📢 Hello Survivors!

It’s been a while since our last update, but for a very important reason. Today is the big day for the major Uncle Z update! We’re introducing new weapons, a new map to explore, and a sinister boss! Most importantly, we completely revamped the connection system between host and client for smoother gameplay. This overhaul took up most of our time, but in our tests, we can confidently say goodbye to input lag. Now, we need your help to consolidate this new system—if you encounter any bugs or input lag, please let us know. Thank you for your patience!

Below is a list of bug fixes and new features:

Balancing:

 Generator now takes longer to deplete.
 Water pump now fills the reservoir more quickly.
 More loot items have been added across all maps.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed synchronization of ambient sounds over time.
 Fixed windows breaking only on the client’s side.
 Fixed item duplication when dropping and picking up items quickly.
 Fixed lag when interacting with objects.
 Fixed lag when picking up items.
 Fixed game freezing when pressing "Esc" on the mission screen.
 Fixed overall input lag.
 Fixed zombies attacking from meters away.
 Fixed ambient sound volume not following settings.


New Features:

 Added a new quest system.
 Added a new dynamic tutorial system.
 Added Halloween-themed elements.
 Added a new Boss.
 Added a new map -> Cemetery.
 Added melee weapons:
     
      Cleaver
      Knife
      Golf Club
      Frying Pan
      Scythe
      Rolling Pin
      Wrench
      Pickaxe
     
 Visual rework on all melee weapons.


With the connection issues partially resolved, we’re back to focusing on content creation. We’re developing a new campaign, expanding existing maps, reworking the zombies’ visuals, and adding more gore—get ready to see heads explode! We’d also like to announce that we’re designing a new combat system aimed at making combat more arcade-style and fluid, with firearms playing a bigger role. All of this will be part of the game’s official launch, which is just around the corner.

We appreciate your feedback and patience. Please keep sending us your suggestions and bug reports. Together, let’s make Uncle Z even better!

Thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Update 0.4.10
notes.notes:
📢 Hello, Survivors!

I have some exciting news to share with you! First, we’ve been working tirelessly on a huge content update for the Steam Halloween event! We’ll be adding new maps, weapons, and exclusive items for the event, along with a surprise… hehe.

Another important update is that we’re developing a brand-new networking system. The current system has been causing input lag and sudden disconnections. This is a major change, and we’ll have to rebuild many things from scratch. We're aiming to bring this new networking system in time for the big Halloween update, but if we don't manage to get it ready, don't worry—it will be coming soon after.

Lastly, we’re excited to announce that our studio now has a new name: Tairound Games!

🔧 Bug Fixes in This Version:

Balancing:


 Survivors now automatically revive at dawn. However, you can still revive your friends at the Command Center.


Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where thrown eggs couldn’t be cleaned up.
 Fixed a crash when cleaning up eggs on the ground.
 Fixed a bug where players were kicked from the session after extinguishing a fire.
 Fixed an issue where players on fire couldn’t interact with the environment.
 Fixed a bug where players and zombies would catch fire, even when there were no flames in the trash pile.


We’re working hard to fix all the bugs you’ve reported, and our top priority is addressing the connection issues that sometimes disrupt your runs. Thank you for your feedback and patience. Please keep sending us your suggestions and bug reports. Together, we’ll make Uncle Z even better!

Thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
📢 Hello, Survivors!

Today, I'm excited to share some important additions and fixes for Uncle Z. My brother and I have worked twice as hard to bring you a large and robust update so you can play without worrying about constant crashes. We're very close to the ideal we aim for, and that's thanks to your feedback and bug reports. The biggest update today is that now you or your friend can join games regardless of how advanced they are. It will no longer be necessary to return to the lobby if an extra friend wants to join the game or if a friend lost their connection during it.

Below is a list of the bugs that have been fixed and the features that have been added:

🔧 Bug Fixes:


 Fixed issue with the lobby when inviting a friend to play.
 Fixed colored cats turning orange when loading a game.
 Fixed stock list overlapping in the player menu.


⚖️ Balancing:

 All items now have their spawn chances doubled.
 It is no longer possible to finish off allies (friendly fire is still valid).
 Zombies no longer invade the player's house until the third day.
 Now, just one click on the taunt buttons makes the player start dancing.
 Expeditions using the wheelbarrow now have a marker indicating their area limit.


✨ Additions:

 Added system where players can join the game at any time.
 New missions tab added to the player menu.
 New tutorials tab added to the player menu.
 Added new tutorials.
 Some tutorials have been reformulated.
 Equipment now appears in the equipment tab in the inventory.


Please remember that some of these modifications and balancing adjustments are temporary to make the game more accessible. We plan to implement all these changes as customizable options in the lobby, so you can adjust the game to your preferred settings.

Keep sending us your suggestions and bug reports. Together, we'll make Uncle Z better and better!

Thank you for your patience and for being part of our community.

notes.title: Update 10/09/2024
notes.notes:
📢 Important Update: Bug Fixes and Balancing 🚀

Hello, Survivors!

We would like to express our immense gratitude for all your feedback and bug reports. Without your help, we wouldn't have discovered even half of these issues. We are always working as quickly as possible to fix them and provide you with a pleasant experience while playing Uncle Z.

Below is a list of bugs that have been fixed and systems that have been balanced:

🔧 Bug Fixes:


 Fixed a critical bug causing an infinite loading screen when starting an expedition.
 Fixed a crash when hitting an ally who had turned into a zombie.
 Fixed an issue where allied zombies did not take damage.
 Fixed a bug where zombies would die standing up when stepping on a bear trap.
 Fixed an issue with allied zombies remaining in the game after returning from expeditions.
 Fixed a bug where ally bodies did not disappear after a day passed or upon returning from expeditions.


⚖️ Balancing Adjustments:


 Reduced the chance of infection from zombie attacks to 20% (previously 40%).
 Increased the energy generator consumption time to 1 every 9 seconds.
 Increased the water pump supply amount to 1 every 4 seconds.
 Removed the cost of reviving allies.


Some of these modifications and balancing adjustments are temporary to make the game more accessible. We plan to make all these changes customizable at the lobby, so you can adjust the game to your preferred settings.

Keep sending us your suggestions and bug reports. Together, we'll make Uncle Z better and better!

Thank you for your patience and for being part of our community. Happy surviving, everyone! 🌟

notes.title: Critical bug fixes
notes.notes:
What has been fixed?

Critical bug when starting an expedition: We identified and fixed an issue that was preventing expeditions from starting correctly. Now, you'll be able to launch your expeditions smoothly and enjoy a more stable and fluid experience.

We're committed to providing the best experience possible for all of you, and we appreciate your patience and feedback to help us constantly improve.
